_comment: Mutation testing for the TypeScript domains; mutmut covers src/hooks/ in the parallel
The kill-rate gate lives in src/release/checkMutationGate.mts, which reads this run's JSON report
and applies src/release/mutation-gate.json — the same file the Python gate reads, so the two
runtimes cannot report two numbers. Stryker's own thresholds stay unset for that reason.
`mutate` skips each domain's bin/: those entry points are logic-free, so every mutant in them is
equivalent or unkillable. Silencing mutants inside real logic is forbidden by the code-of-conduct.
`coverageAnalysis: all` rather than perTest, which mis-attributes coverage under the Vitest runner.
